transcript: When I booked my ticket to Shit. Meet Fan. at MCC, I was already sold on it being written and directed by Robert O'hara. Then I found out it was going to feature Neil Patrick Harris, Jane Krakowski, Debra Messing, and Constance Wu, and I was super sold. Then I found out it's based on the film Perfect Strangers, and I knew it would deliver, and it did. This is a comedy about a Brooklyn cocktail party gone awry, scandalous secrets revealed, plenty of twists and turns, and an insufferable but entertaining group of mostly rich and shallow characters. Basically, they all agree to put their phones on the table and read any communications that come in publicly — the skeletons that come out are pretty wild and as the title warns, shit indeed meet fan. It’s probably not the most realistic plot, nor is it the most mind blowing thing I've ever seen, but it was a damn good time. And the cast is just as excellent as you'd expect, and plenty of times they're able to take a line that's moderately funny and make it really hilarious through impeccable delivery and timing. The ensemble work is super tight and the play flows quite effortlessly. Shit. Meet. Fan. has already extended twice and is currently booking through December 15th. With that, another program for my collection.
